<cite ref="Bava Batra 4a:5">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>בתר דעבדין מִתְמַלְּכִין</he> do people ask for advice (or permission) after they have acted? <cite ref="Berakhot 27b:22">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>אִימְּלִיךְ וכ׳</he> consult my family.
<cite ref="Berakhot 27b">Ib.</cite> <he>אזיל ואִמְּ׳ וכ׳</he> he went and consulted his wife.

<cite ref="Nedarim 54a:4">Ned. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מילתא דצריך שליחא לאִמְּלוּכֵי וכ׳</he> any change of order for which the messenger has to ask special authorization, is heterogeneous (to the object of the original commission); <he>כל מילתא דמִימְּלִיךְ שליח עלה וכ׳</he> a change for which the messenger asks for instructions is homogeneous.
<cite ref="Sotah 43b:9">Sot. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>אי אימ׳ עלה</he> if he reconsiders his original disposal; a. fr.
